changelog: - **A mentorship relation's project and cohort follow the company rule: ADMIN only, and only within the admin's own tenant** (#2618, the follow-up to #2613). `projectId` and `cohortId` on `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]` (and `projectId` on `POST /api/mentorship`) were free strings. The project one granted access: an ACTIVE relation's `projectId` is project-team membership for both its people (`isProjectMember`/`loadProjectTeam`, #1026), so a mentor could point their own relation at any private project — another tenant's included while `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` is off — and open it; an ADMIN could attach another tenant's project or cohort, `POST`'s `include` returned the project's name, and an unknown id was a foreign-key 500. A non-admin changing either now gets **403 `project_change_admin_only` / `cohort_change_admin_only`** before any lookup (echoing the current value stays a no-op; only `/admin/candidates/[id]` sends them), and targets are resolved in the caller's tenant — foreign and unknown ids answer the same **404 `project_not_found` / `cohort_not_found`**, and a request with one bad target writes none of them. `src/lib/relationCompany.ts` becomes `src/lib/relationTargets.ts` (`refuseForeignTargets()` over company, project and cohort); `e2e/relation-company-guard.spec.ts` becomes `relation-targets-guard.spec.ts` with the project/cohort cases, including the mentor still being refused the private project after the attempt.
